name: application-timezone-picker
title: Timezone Picker
description: Searchable timezone picker where each option shows the city, UTC offset, and current local time, filtered by real search state.
useWhen: Scheduling a meeting or event where the user needs to pick a timezone rather than a specific time.
Showing the current local time alongside each timezone option helps users disambiguate similarly-named or unfamiliar zones.
The timezone list is long enough that free-text search meaningfully speeds up finding one.
avoidWhen: You need to pick a specific clock time, not a timezone — use a time input or `time-picker` instead.
The app only supports a single fixed timezone — there's nothing to pick.
You need raw IANA timezone identifiers rather than city-based labels — adapt the option data model, since this pattern's UX is built around recognizable city names.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width popover-style panel with an internally scrolling list (max-height) so a long timezone list doesn't grow the panel unbounded.
accessibility: The list has role="listbox" with an aria-label describing it as Timezone, and each option is role="option" with aria-selected reflecting the active choice.
The search field has an associated (visually hidden) label rather than relying on placeholder text alone.
An empty search result state renders visible text ("No matching timezones") rather than a silently empty list.
Each option's city name, offset, and current time are all real text, not encoded only in position or color.

variants.title: Timezone Picker
variants.description: Search field and five timezone options with city, UTC offset, and current time, San Francisco selected.
accessibility: Typing filters the real timezone list by city name or offset text, not a static hardcoded subset.

variants.title: Timezone Picker (Dark)
variants.description: Timezone picker adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-row and hover backgrounds are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
